text: Of great weight in the attainment of virtue, fellow-citizens, are habits, instruction, precepts, and indeed the whole manner of life... These whelps were both of one litter, but differently bred; the one, you see, has turned out a greedy cur, and the other a good hound.
author: Plutarch
speaker: Lycurgus
locator: A Discourse Touching the Training of Children, 4
